sentence: Spur gear pair, module 1, 20 and 40 teeth, bores with keyways, centre distance certified
design_notes: Tooth outlines are polylines from docs/receipts/g3/gear.py (4 flank stations, 0.05 backlash): the kernel has no involute or gear feature. Bores 8 and 10 with DIN 6885-1 hub keyways built by the keyway feature from the records (2 wide, t2 1.0; 3 wide, t2 1.4); the 6 mm pinion bore the agent first drew has no DIN 6885-1 row (the table starts over 6 mm), and its hand-drawn 2 x 1.0 keyways were not checked against anything. Face width 8.
